name: unknown-stays-unknown

_doc: Plain words: the repo says nothing about billing or production. The absence of information stays an absence: the answer says it cannot be known from here, it does not turn it into a yes or a firm no.

pass: I cannot tell from this repository: there is no reference to a billing service, so it stays unknown.
